name.en: Shu–Osher: characteristic WENO-Z and a numerical reference

note.ja: 初期不連続x=−4、左状態は固定入力を参照。特性有限差分WENO5-Zの点値を比較する。800点参照は同一方式の数値解であり、厳密解・独立ソルバーではない。
note.en: Initial jump at x=−4; see the fixed input for the left state. Compares characteristic finite-difference WENO5-Z point values. The 800-point reference is neither exact nor an independent solver.

note.en: Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code.

reference_note.en: Distinguish the stored high-resolution WENO-Z numerical reference from the separately distributed independent Athena++ reference. Neither is claimed as an exact solution of this shock–density-wave interaction.

method_note.ja: この問題に明示的に結び付けられた補助実行例と、存在する場合は共通実行例の手法です。別問題の配布物を借用していません。
method_note.en: Methods from explicitly bound supplementary examples and, where present, the common execution example. No release for a different problem is borrowed.

name.en: Shu–Osher: characteristic WENO-Z and a numerical reference

scope.ja: [-5,5]で衝撃波と密度正弦波の干渉をt=1.8まで計算。100/200点の特性FD WENO-Zを800点の同じ実装と比較し、参照との差と近似境界収支を別々に記録する。
scope.en: Evolve shock/entropy-wave interaction on [-5,5] to t=1.8. Compare characteristic FD WENO-Z at 100/200 points with the same implementation at 800 points, separately recording reference disagreement and approximate boundary balance.

assumptions.ja: γ=1.4、初期不連続x=−4、左(ρ,u,p)=(3.857143,2.629369,10.33333)、右ρ=1+0.2sin(5x),u=0,p=1。初期不連続を各格子の界面へ合わせる。点値FD、大域LF分割、界面固定Roe特性基底、WENO-Z指数2、ε=10^-6、SSPRK3、CFL=0.3。
assumptions.en: γ=1.4, initial jump x=−4, left (ρ,u,p)=(3.857143,2.629369,10.33333), and right ρ=1+0.2sin(5x), u=0, p=1. The initial jump aligns with a face on every grid. Pointwise FD, global LF splitting, face-frozen Roe characteristics, WENO-Z exponent 2, ε=10^-6, SSPRK3 and CFL=0.3 are used.

limits.ja: 800点は同一手法の数値参照で、厳密解や独立solverではない。0.15の平均密度差は構造の再現を見る教材用の解像度基準であり、高精度認証ではない。格子倍増で差が減ることだけを判定し、形式次数は付与しない。正の出力と棄却回数を記録しても、全入力の正値性定理にはならない。
limits.en: The 800-point solution is a same-method numerical reference, not an exact solution or independent solver. The mean-density difference bound of 0.15 is an educational structure-resolution criterion, not a high-accuracy certification. Only decreasing discrepancy under grid doubling is tested; no formal order is assigned. Positive outputs and counted rejections do not establish positivity for every input.

reference_note.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
reference_note.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.

description.ja: 高解像度の保存変数の点値を各100/200点の格子中心へ線形補間する。誤差はそれぞれ同じ場所・t=1.8で平均する。CSVは200点の計算・参照を並べる。近似収支の許容値0.2%は固定境界の離散化誤差を許すためであり、密度誤差0.15の判定とは別。
description.en: Higher-resolution conserved point values are linearly interpolated to each 100/200-point grid's centers. Errors are averaged at matching locations and t=1.8; CSV pairs the 200-point solution and reference. The 0.2% approximate-balance allowance accommodates fixed-boundary discretization and is separate from the density-error bound of 0.15.

name.en: Shu–Osher: independent reference and mesh refinement

scope.ja: 衝撃波と密度正弦波の相互作用を、同じPython実装の細格子ではなく、別に実行したAthena++の参照と照合します。
scope.en: Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code.

limits.ja: 参照は厳密解ではなく独立した有限格子数値解です。異なる流束系列すべての優劣、WENOの一般的高次数、負圧防止の保証には広げません。 参照2048→4096のL1差0.005346は事前幅0.005を満たさず、8192へ細分しました。途中の未達記録も残します。
limits.en: The reference is an independent finite-grid numerical solution, not an exact solution. No universal flux ranking, WENO-order claim or positivity guarantee is inferred. The 2048-to-4096 reference L1 increment0.005346 missed the predeclared0.005 bound, so8192 cells were added. The earlier miss remains recorded.

reference_note.ja: 100/200/400セルの密度L1誤差と改善率、正値性を測り、参照2048/4096/8192セルの差も事前幅と比較します。境界へ衝撃波が届かない固定時刻で比較します。
reference_note.en: Measure density L1 error, refinement and positivity on 100/200/400 cells; also compare 2048/4096/8192 reference differences with a predeclared bound. The shock has not reached the boundaries at the fixed comparison time.
